answer: When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 2 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. The gale record keeps the spread, river schedules the escalation, and wharf publishes the outcome. A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors as a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. A 396 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
